problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate the annual infrastructure budget across 16 different project categories to maximize the total community benefit score.  
The profile for each project category is as follows:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.168, impact index 0.018, allocation limits [0.069, 0.869]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.189, impact index 0.025, allocation limits [0.079, 0.854]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.105, impact index 0.196, allocation limits [0.032, 0.688]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.094, impact index 0.193, allocation limits [0.048, 0.676]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.171, impact index 0.239, allocation limits [0.074, 0.844]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.149, impact index 0.049, allocation limits [0.026, 0.884]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.178, impact index 0.126, allocation limits [0.069, 0.419]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.168, impact index 0.192, allocation limits [0.083, 0.721]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.168, impact index 0.101, allocation limits [0.080, 0.401]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.146, impact index 0.034, allocation limits [0.020, 0.541]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.111, impact index 0.056, allocation limits [0.041, 0.557]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.083, impact index 0.160, allocation limits [0.018, 0.456]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.128, impact index 0.291, allocation limits [0.088, 0.353]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.166, impact index 0.251, allocation limits [0.094, 0.521]  
* Project O: benefit score 0.153, impact index 0.231, allocation limits [0.088, 0.868]  
* Project P: benefit score 0.102, impact index 0.256, allocation limits [0.022, 0.370]  

Each project category must receive a budget share within its specified limits, and the total allocation across all categories must sum to 1. To ensure rapid implementation, the planner requires that the group of quick-start projects, represented by the set Q = {C, G, N, O, P}, collectively receive at least 0.306 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the overall infrastructure impact index must not exceed 0.181, and the total community benefit score must be at least 0.143.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total community benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
